The terminal app is rewritten from scratch in TypeScript on OpenTUI. It replaces the Python/Textual app from v5.x and ships as a single-file binary for macOS, Linux and Windows.

## Highlights

- **One screen.** The course list sits beside the selected course, with tabs for files, assignments, grades and announcements.
- **Attendance maths.** Each course shows its percentage against a 75% requirement, plus how many classes you can still miss, or how many in a row you need to attend to get back.
- **A "needs you" strip.** Unsubmitted assignments that are due soon and courses below the attendance requirement, in one line above the course list.
- **Bulk downloads.** Mark courses with `space`, press `d`. Files go to `~/Downloads/MyDy/<course>/`, and files you already have are skipped.
- **Works offline.** The last synced data is cached, so you can still read it when MyDy is unreachable.
- **Saved login.** Sign in once with Remember me on (the default) and the login is kept in the system keychain. The app signs back in by itself when the session expires.
- **Mouse support.** Click to select, click again to open, scroll to move.
- **Icons.** Nerd Font icons, with a plain Unicode fallback (`--no-nerd-font`).

## Install

Download the binary for your system from the assets below.

| System | File |
|---|---|
| macOS, Apple Silicon | `mydy-darwin-arm64` |
| macOS, Intel | `mydy-darwin-x64` |
| Linux, x64 | `mydy-linux-x64` |
| Linux, ARM64 | `mydy-linux-arm64` |
| Windows, x64 | `mydy-windows-x64.exe` |

macOS and Linux:

```sh
chmod +x mydy-darwin-arm64
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine mydy-darwin-arm64   # macOS only
./mydy-darwin-arm64
```

On Windows, run `mydy-windows-x64.exe` from a terminal.

The binaries are not signed or notarized. On macOS the `xattr` line above is required. On Windows, SmartScreen may ask you to confirm.

Sign in with `MYDY_USERNAME` and `MYDY_PASSWORD` (environment or a `.env` file), a saved login, or the sign-in screen, in that order. Keys, icons and configuration are covered in the [TUI guide](https://github.com/Deeptanshuu/mydy-lms-helper/blob/main/tui/README.md).

## Notes

- **Assets are renamed.** v5.x shipped `lms_helper_*` files. From this release they are `mydy-<os>-<arch>`.
- **The MCP server moved** from `tui/` to `mcp/`. If you registered it with an MCP client, point it at `mcp/mcp_server.py`. Setup is in the [MCP guide](https://github.com/Deeptanshuu/mydy-lms-helper/blob/main/mcp/README.md).
- **Config file** (optional): `~/.config/mydy/config.json`, or `%APPDATA%\mydy\config.json` on Windows. Keys: `downloadDir`, `nerdFont`, `threshold`.
- **Linux builds target glibc distributions.** They are not built for musl-based systems such as Alpine.
- **Nerd Font:** use the regular variant (for example JetBrainsMono Nerd Font), not the Mono variant.
- The Chrome extension is released separately, under `ext-v*` tags.
- Website and live demo: https://deeptanshuu.github.io/mydy-lms-helper/

Unofficial and not affiliated with D.Y. Patil or MyDy. Your login is only sent to MyDy.
